about_the_game:
Field of Enemies — Survive, Upgrade, Become a Legend!

Dive into the chaotic and fun Low Poly world of "Field of Enemies"! This is a casual top-down action roguelike where you'll face endless hordes of enemies, from clumsy zombies to advanced robots. Your goal is simple: survive as long as you can, surrounding yourself with a literal hellscape of monsters, and etch your name into the history of the leaderboards!

Fight alone or team up with friends – co-op for up to 4 players turns survival into an incredibly fun and crazy battle!

Why players will love Field of Enemies:

  • Dynamic Fights to the Last Breath: Every second counts. Change your tactics on the fly: go for an all-out attack, choose cunning abilities, or just run away before you become prey! Your choice is your path to a new record.

  • Deep Progression and Build Crafting: Kill enemies, gain experience, and unlock powerful unique abilities. Combine them to create unique builds that suit your playstyle. Become an unstoppable warrior or a cunning tactician!

  • Crazy Co-op for Up to 4 Players: Want more chaos? Invite your friends! Co-op play opens up new tactical possibilities and triples the fun. Can you work as a team when a horde is rushing at you from all sides?

  • Unique Atmosphere and Humor: Enjoy stylish Low Poly graphics and... a unique soundtrack! All in-game sounds, from gunshots to monster screams, are voice-acted, creating an unparalleled comedic atmosphere. And during hot battles, you'll be charged up by epic, dynamic music.

  • Escalating Difficulty: The challenge grows with your power. Can you keep up?

  • Competitive Spirit: Fight not just for survival, but for a place at the top. The global leaderboard will show who is the true king of the battlefield.

Field of Enemies is an endless hurricane of action, humor, and excitement, where every run is unique, and records are made to be broken!
